boundary: Real, unmodified native auth.api Passkey routes and SimpleWebAuthn verification. Registration uses the documented requireSession:false and resolveUser configuration. The first capture uses the existing authenticator only to prepare valid key material and signed assertions; replay uses every frozen input byte and never imports that signer. Real signed cookies and internal verification consumption remain active. Adapter recorders inject only the declared failures; missing-user projects the User query to null without deleting the stored User. The createSession recorder forwards a fixed token through the supported overrideAll argument and retains real session persistence. Complete request, challenge JSON, storage, errors, descriptors, key order, identities and raw stacks are retained. The runtime observation excludes host stack text and descriptor internals; raw observations retain both. Browser transport, default registration session middleware, SQL transactions and the Rust WebAuthn engine's private challenge payload are separate, unpaired boundaries. Existing captures are neither resampled nor replaced.
